_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B4: H2 proper on the two confirmatory Russian-adapted Qwen models, one per card. Plan ru_probe: the four Russian pre-cutoff files of AMENDMENT_1 with rows under 200 tokens (hflabs_city, govdomains, mos_zemelnye_uchastki, mos_torgovye_obekty), the fresh control trudvsem_vacancies_2026, and iris as the in-session anchor. These are the same cells on which the Nemo pair (C1) and the YandexGPT pair (Y3) were negative, and govdomains fired only through near-duplicate rows. T-lite-it-1.0 and ruadapt_qwen2.5_7B_ext_u48_instruct are the confirmatory Russian-centric models of PREREGISTRATION.md §3 and have not yet met these files. On exposure_2 (B3) neither named OKVED 2 codes above the lookup baseline (10 and 4 of 250, against Qwen's 11 and YandexGPT's 28-32). iris must return 95/142 and 76/142, byte for byte, as in B1-B3. russian_retail (ru_probe_long) does not fit: 15.6 h for T-lite and 13.1 h for ruadapt by the planning figure. Planning figures from src/price_plan.py with each model's own tokenizer, every answer to its budget x 1.15, validated on 39 runs (actual/plan 0.71-0.94; B3's two runs 0.71 and 0.73): T-lite 7.2 h, ruadapt 6.9 h. The longer card is 7.2 h, about 5.4 h at B3's ratio.
attached_input: trudvsem_vacancies_2026.csv — the frozen fresh control, attached as a Kaggle dataset as in sessions C1 and Y3; it cannot be re-fetched. The other four Russian files are fetched from their registered sources and hash-checked before any weights load
disk: two checkpoints at once, about 31 GB at the peak (T-lite 15.2 + ruadapt-Qwen 15.5, neither with custom code)

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: header and row completion on the AMENDMENT_1 files and the fresh control; 7.2 h; H2 for the continued-pretraining adaptation of Qwen2.5-7B. iris anchors the plan (95/142)
the same cells, same seed, the other card; 6.9 h; H2 for the vocabulary-extended adaptation. iris anchors the plan (76/142). Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
